# Assessment Facts Overview

This directory contains supplementary architecture and operational documents for the assessment.
- [api-service-contracts.md](api-service-contracts.md) — Service catalog, API surface, and synchronous communication contracts.
- [architecture-diagram.md](architecture-diagram.md) — High-level application architecture and component relationships.
- [business-workflows.md](business-workflows.md) — Catalog domain entities, business workflows, and decision rules.
- [configuration-inventory.md](configuration-inventory.md) — Configuration sources, profiles, runtime settings, and secrets handling.
- [data-architecture.md](data-architecture.md) — Database configuration, entities, ownership, and persistence patterns.
- [dependency-map.md](dependency-map.md) — Declared NuGet dependencies, compatibility risks, and test dependencies.
